title: Seating and night routine: residents sit in chairs and sleep in beds
player_outcome: At night, residents walk home, sit in their room's chair and later lie down in a bed if there is one. In the morning they get up and wander.
design: Core: TownNpc.Seat (long? tile object id) and Posture (from P5-08). New TownSystem.Seating.cs: UpdateSeat(r) is called from Decide. At night, when a housed resident reaches home (distance < 0.5 m) and is not talking or under threat, take a free chair, then after 22:00 a bed. The room's Furniture comes from Rooms.Get(home) (housing role 'chair'; 'bed' needs a bed with a 'bed' housing role). By day, idle at home, sit with a 30% chance for IdleTicks.

Path to the chair: NearestStandable next to the chair's anchor → GoTo. On arrival snap Position to SeatPoint(chair) = anchor centre + SeatHeight (a new TileObjectDef.SeatHeight in cells, default 1; beds use BedHeight), set Yaw from the chair's rotation quarter, and set Posture Sit or Sleep.

Stand up (Posture Stand, Seat null, nudge to a standable node): at hour ≥ 5.5 plus a random delay, on BeginTalk (then face the player), when TickDefense finds a threat, or when TileObjects.Removed hits the seat id. Two residents never share a chair (a HashSet of taken seat ids, rebuilt per scan).
Renderer: Sit and Sleep postures are already mapped (P5-08). The seat height is in Core Position, so the renderer only uses the yaw.
TownProbes: town.<id>.sitting (1 when Sit or Sleep).
